warnings: Machine-generated transcript in Kazakh, Russian or English; it can contain errors. Check the audio before relying on it.
Turn times are approximate. Review flags use simple score thresholds, not calibrated confidence.

Two people at the same time: the whole recording was split into two voices by the separator of the English two-voice mode, and each voice was transcribed on its own. This setting is a demonstration, not measured on a test set; words can be lost or given to the wrong voice.
Speaker 1, Speaker 2, … are labels inside this recording, not identified people. Short interjections can be attached to the wrong speaker.
The language was detected turn by turn among Kazakh, Russian and English. A language change in the middle of a turn, or a very short turn, can be written in the wrong language.
The ClearTalk multilingual recognizer was fine-tuned on read sentences and short phrases; its measured gains do not guarantee better text on every recording.
